Figshare API (v2) responses, recorded once on 2026-10-19 with the Pinakes user agent
(`pinakes/0.1.0 (+https://pubky.app; info@synonym.to)`), about one request every two seconds
(Figshare asks for about one a second). Parser regression fixtures for
`pinakes_core::sources::figshare`; test runs make no requests.

`provenance.json` lists each fixture's request URL, status, content type, recording time, and the
size and SHA-256 of the body as served. Figshare's metadata is available under CC0; each
article's content is under the licence it states (`license`).
